## **Preis und Paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Preis und Paywall.**
      1 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen preis und paywall.
      Review-Fenster: 04.08.2026 - 04.08.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer erwähnen Preis, Abos oder Paywalls. Das kann Preissensibilität in der Nische signalisieren.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _Fadi Mujahid_, 04.08.2026, 3/5: "The app is very good at what it does and I purchased the premium app. However, the app keeps Google Play Service up all the time which results in battery drainage, which is very frustrating. Unlike other apps which might use Google services to check on the purchase, this app checks with this service on each click. Very unprofessional"
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Bugs und Stabilität** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs und Stabilität.**
      2 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen bugs und stabilität.
      Review-Fenster: 27.09.2026 - 01.10.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer erwähnen Crashes oder Instabilität. Nur bei Volume-Spike oder nach einem Update als actionable werten; sonst oft Baseline-Rauschen.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _blackburn_, 01.10.2026, 1/5: "Broken for a year. Widgets are all permanently glitched. Support blames Android for their widgets not updating but it's been going on for most of a year now and no other widgets I use are broken. Assume they've just abandoned the android version."
            2. _Ed Nafziger_, 27.09.2026, 3/5: "I take about 10 vitamins 7 times a day. This app is very slow and tedious to add multiple reminders to the same habit. You have to add one at a time. Unfortunately, that makes using this app terrible for me. The "Tally Tracker" app does it right. There is no way to duplicate habits. The calendar row at the top can be scrolled into the future which doesn't make any sense to me."
<!--/ir-theme-->
